strengths: All crypto delegated to @noble/* libraries (curves, ciphers, hashes) — satisfies the 'no hand-roll Ed25519 or AEAD' quality bar (keys.ts, sign.ts, encrypt.ts)
DELIVERABLE fully covered: round-trip encrypt/sign/verify/decrypt, tampered-sig rejection, and no-private-key-exposure are each backed by a dedicated test (envelope.test.ts:13, 34, 52)

Correct crypto ordering: verify-then-decrypt in decryptEnvelopePayload (envelope.ts:104-107); encrypt derives an ECDH shared secret via Ed25519->Montgomery conversion and HKDF-SHA256, symmetric across sender/recipient (encrypt.ts:10-21)
Deterministic canonical signing bytes via alphabetically-ordered field object, avoiding JSON key-order ambiguity (envelope.ts:43-55)
Clean separation of concerns across keys/sign/encrypt/envelope modules; envelope excludes secret material from the serialized shape (Envelope interface, envelope.ts:10-20)
Decrypt guards against truncated ciphertext with an explicit length check (encrypt.ts:46-48)

issues.description: Magic number 16 (Poly1305 tag length) in the payload length check should be a named constant for readability

randomNonce() and randomEnvelopeId() are exported but unused within T2's scope (appear intended for later tasks e.g. relay challenge nonces); randomNonce defaults to 32 bytes which does not match the 24-byte XChaCha nonce, so callers must pass the correct length — mild footgun
